snippet.title: Survival Machine - Release Date Teaser
snippet.description:
Survival Machine, the latest survival-adventure game from Grapes Pickers studio, will be available on Steam in Early Access starting May 7th! 

Get ready to embark on a co-op survival adventure like no other! Survival Machine is a 4-player third-person survival game where you and your friends explore vibrant, ever-changing biomes — all while riding atop a giant, upgradable Machine that’s your base, your transport, and your fortress.
Build. Explore. Survive.
